title: How each tool works
subtitle: A closer look at what happens behind the scenes when you process a file.

merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.whatItDoes: Takes two or more PDF files and combines them into a single document. Pages are joined in the order you specify — you can drag to rearrange before merging. No quality loss, no re-rendering.
steps: You upload multiple PDF files via drag-and-drop or file picker.
pdf-lib reads each file's page tree and copies pages into a new document object — entirely in your browser.
The merged PDF is serialized and downloaded. Your files are never uploaded to any server.

split.title: Split PDF
split.whatItDoes: Loads a PDF and renders visual previews of every page using pdf.js. You select which pages to extract, and pdf-lib creates a new PDF containing only those pages.
steps: pdf.js (Mozilla) renders each page as a canvas thumbnail in your browser — this is only for visual preview, not manipulation.
You click the pages you want to keep. Selections are stored as an array of page indices.
pdf-lib copies only the selected pages from the original PDF into a new document, which is then downloaded.

ocr.title: OCR PDF
ocr.whatItDoes: Takes a scanned PDF (essentially images of pages) and runs optical character recognition to add a searchable text layer. The output looks identical but you can now select, search, and copy text from it.
steps: Your PDF is uploaded to our server via a secure connection and placed in a processing queue.
PyMuPDF renders each page as a high-resolution image. pytesseract analyzes each image and extracts text with position data.
The recognized text is embedded as an invisible layer over the original page images. The file is returned and automatically deleted.

pdfToWord.title: PDF to Word
pdfToWord.whatItDoes: Converts a PDF into an editable .docx file. Preserves paragraphs, headings, tables, and basic formatting. Works best with digitally created PDFs.
steps: PDF is uploaded to the server and queued for asynchronous processing.
pdf2docx parses the PDF's internal structure — text blocks, fonts, spacing, tables — and maps them to Word document elements.
A .docx file is generated and sent back for download. The server file is purged after delivery.
pdfToWord.warning: pdf2docx works on native/digital PDFs. If your PDF is a scanned image, run OCR first, then convert. The tool cannot extract text from images directly.

imageToPdf.title: Image to PDF
imageToPdf.whatItDoes: Converts one or more images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a PDF document. Each image becomes a full page. You can also mix images and combine them into a multi-page PDF.
steps: Images are loaded into the browser. HTML5 Canvas reads each image's dimensions and converts it to raw bytes.
pdf-lib creates a new page matching each image's aspect ratio and embeds the image data directly into the PDF.
The resulting PDF is generated and downloaded. Everything stays in your browser — no server upload.
